simple.meaning: Adonikam , the name of one or two Israelites
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲדֹנִיקָם (H140) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲדֹנִיקָם (ʼĂdônîyqâm) means Adonikam , the name of one or two Israelites First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 13.

definitions.short: Adonikam , the name of one or two Israelites
definitions.full: H140. Adoniqam אֲדֹנִיקָם proper name, masculine ( my Lord has arisen ) head of a family Ezra 2:13 ; 8:13 ; Neh 7:18 ( אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ 10:17 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 113 and 6965 ; lord of rising (i.e. high);
